title: Weighted approximate tangent planes are local
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^N open, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, y ∈ O and P ≤ ℝ^N a linear subspace. Then O ∩ M has weighted approximate tangent space P at y with respect to θ (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (O ∩ M) θ y P) if and only if M has weighted approximate tangent space P at y with respect to θ (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y P).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (O M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (y : Euclidean N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (O ∩ M) θ y P ↔ Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y P)
